original_metadata.title: The round six-sphere has no almost complex structure J satisfying nabla_(JX)J=J*nabla_X J for every tangent vector X, where nabla is its standard Levi-Civita connection
original_metadata.author: Scott O. Wilson
original_metadata.source_title: Results Concerning Almost Complex Structures on the Six-Sphere
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The final cohomological contradiction depends on an explicit Grassmann-valued map that works for nonorthogonal almost complex structures. The author proves immersion using the moving normal line and identifies the entire anti-holomorphic differential with the connection-dependent tangent algebra. This construction and its complementary-summand analysis extend beyond the usual orthogonal integrability obstruction.

proof_review.note: The full Grassmann-map construction and proof5.2/5.3, the strong-integrability definitions2.2/2.3/2.7, and the projection-manifold/Kahler structure in Section3 were read. The author includes the normal line in the orthogonal projection onto T^(0,1) plus the normal bundle, proves immersion, computes its anti-holomorphic differential in terms of the tangent algebra and checks the complementary summand by self-adjointness. If strong integrability held, this would be a J-holomorphic immersion into a compact Kahler Grassmannian; the closed nondegenerate pullback contradicts H^2(S^6)=0. All new construction needed for the short final corollary is bundled. No claim that every integrable almost complex structure is strongly integrable is made.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Exactly Corollary5.4 on S^6 with the round standard metric and its Levi-Civita connection: no smooth almost complex J has nabla_(JX)J=J*nabla_X J for all real tangent X. Bundle Theorem5.3 and Lemma5.2. The condition is strong integrability for this fixed connection; it is stronger than ordinary integrability. No resolution of the general complex-structure problem on S^6 is asserted, and no separate projection formula or orthogonal-structure variant is counted.
original_metadata.source_boundary_note: The selected unit is the author-positioned main nonexistence outcome on the round S^6, with the complete genuinely new normal-line-modified Grassmann-map construction bundled into its proof. Theorem 5.3 is not treated as a standard prerequisite: its full immersion, anti-holomorphic differential and complementary-summand calculation are supplied, along with all connection/strong-integrability, idempotent Grassmann/Kahler and normal-bundle setup. The short final cohomological contradiction is the closure of that new geometric construction. The canonical projection/pullback formulas are retained as uncounted context; no auxiliary result is counted separately. Strong integrability for the fixed standard Levi-Civita connection is stronger than ordinary integrability; no resolution of the general complex-structure problem on S^6 is asserted.
